item.title: Rivalry lives on as Bruins top Canadiens in heated showdown
item.description: The Associated PressMONTREAL — Jeremy Swayman stopped 26 shots for his fifth consecutive victory and the Boston Bruins overcame the loss of defenseman Charlie McAvoy to a mouth injury to beat the Montreal Canadiens 3-2 on Saturday night in a heated game. item.title: NSCC granted $19,514 for hunger-free campus
item.description: Jackie MannoThe Healey-Driscoll administration has granted North Shore Community College $19,514 in Hunger Free Campus Initiative grants to support initiatives such as food pantries, meal vouchers, and SNAP outreach, in response to the uncertainty of SNAP benefits. item.title: Saugus builds a bridge through art
item.description: Elizabeth Della PianaResidents of Saugus are invited to participate in a town-wide art project called The Bridge, which will be a celebration of the community's cultural identities and stories, and will be unveiled at the Saugus Community Festival on March 21.
